caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular woven textile with a repeating geometric and floral pattern. The colors used are primarily red, green, blue, and white. The composition features alternating horizontal bands: the red bands contain white floral star motifs and small circular and oval elements, while the green bands are filled with mirrored leafy shapes and blue horizontal linear accents. There is a blue segment in the bottom left corner containing white text that reads "BY JOHN RACHEL ANN SMITH 1849" in block letters, along with miniature floral patterns. The textile has fringed edges on the left and is neatly bordered on the other sides. At the bottom right of the drawing, the scale "Scale 1' = 10'" is noted, and signature credits are present in the bottom margin, reading "S. Freeman - Del: 15-6-1" and "G. Smith."
title: Woven Quilt
